Insider threats come from employees, contractors, or former employees who have access to sensitive information. These threats can be intentional (e.g., stealing data) or unintentional (e.g., accidentally sharing confidential information).

Physical security breaches involve unauthorized access to physical locations where sensitive data is stored.
